name: papermc
summary: Performance-focused Minecraft server platform for game hosting, plugin ecosystems, and automation workflows.
why_it_matters: PaperMC preserves useful game-server capability knowledge, but there is no active scenario demand that justifies maintaining it as a supported resource.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs a Minecraft server backend.
Operators want plugin-capable game hosting with automation hooks.
The workflow depends on a Minecraft world as an application surface.

platform_support.notes: The Java server is portable, but support quality depends on plugin management, world persistence, and host performance expectations.

implementation_notes: Promotion should validate a narrow server lifecycle and automation workflow.
Keep server provisioning distinct from RCON or gameplay automations.
Plugin sprawl should be avoided unless explicitly supported.
operational_notes: World persistence and backups are core operator concerns.
Validation should prove server startup and safe command execution.
Support quality depends heavily on plugin scope.
risks: Game-server ecosystems become maintenance traps without active users.
A wrapper can imply stronger world and plugin support than exists.
